MetricCellV1.description:
A series cell omits VALID, COMPLETE and empty reasons when they are exact defaults.

The defaults apply only inside metric-series.v1 cells. Expanded MetricValueV1
and aggregate metrics still carry their explicit quality fields.
MetricCellV1.title: MetricCellV1

MetricValueV1.description: Expanded per-instrument value; consumers receive this shape after series resolution.
MetricValueV1.title: MetricValueV1

MicrostructureRefV1.description: Optional pointer to a snapshot-scoped, separately bounded companion.
MicrostructureRefV1.title: MicrostructureRefV1

NormalizedBreadthV1.description: Additive 1bp breadth view; absent on frames written before this extension.
NormalizedBreadthV1.title: NormalizedBreadthV1

RegimeObservationRefV1.description: Owner regime record plus an API-local join key; semantics remain engine-owned.
RegimeObservationRefV1.title: RegimeObservationRefV1

RelativeStrengthChangesV1.description: Compact 1h rank movement; positive rank deltas mean stronger rank.
RelativeStrengthChangesV1.title: RelativeStrengthChangesV1
